cellar.label: a cellar
cellar.does: food keeps at a quarter of the house rate (40 a space of the building's ground)

millstones.label: dressed millstones

water wheel.label: a water wheel and leat

stalls.label: stalls

woodshed.label: a woodshed

vault.label: a vault

medium room.label: a medium room (timber on stone, or stone)

hall.label: a hall (timber on stone, or stone)

camp.label: a camp (a lean-to and a fire ring)
